        status = exp.get('status', 'unknown')
        conclusion = exp.get('conclusion', '')
    else:
        status = exp.get('status', 'unknown')
        conclusion = exp.get('conclusion', '')
    key = f'{status}/{conclusion}' if conclusion else status

for k, v in sorted(status_counter.items()):
